        path: pages/paed_ref.qmd
        image: assets/millipaed_smol.jpg
        description: |
          A universal dose-finding app for paediatric anaesthesia, covering drug doses, equipment sizes and vital signs. The source data are published on this site as a standalone [Paediatric Dose Reference](pages/paed_ref.qmd); the app itself is currently private due to app store restrictions for drug dose calculators.
      - title: "SquareTable"
        path: https://github.com/cjdbarlow/squaretable-vs
        image: assets/software/squaretable.svg
        description: |
          An editor extension for painless writing Markdown (and Pandoc Markdown! Grid tables!). It aligns columns as you type, allows easy removal or reordering of rows/columns/cells/lines, and generally makes writing Part One and Bedside Notebook much, much easier. Available for [VS Code](https://github.com/cjdbarlow/squaretable-vs) and [Sublime Text](https://github.com/cjdbarlow/squaretable-st).
      - title: "Part One (The App)"
        path: https://github.com/cjdbarlow/Part-One-app
        image: assets/software/part-one.svg
        description: |
          A Flutter app for reading [Part One](https://partone.litfl.com/) offline on iPhone, iPad and Android. Designed to be easily forked for other Quarto projects. [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/cjdbarlow/Part-One-app).
